description: Four dancers each spin once to the right and travel one place round the ring.

walkthrough.line: Spin once round to your own right and travel {places} round the set as you go.
walkthrough.teach: Hands free, spin once round to your own right and travel clockwise round the set as you spin — {places} — so the four of you move round the ring together. Four beats, and the hands come up and out as you go.
